claims.text: Greg (Bloom Nutrition co-founder, speaking in 2024 as company approached $500M+ annual revenue) asserts that entrepreneurship is a very lonely chapter, but building a company alongside a best friend makes the experience more rewarding than solo entrepreneurship already is.
claims.speaker: Greg (Bloom Nutrition co-founder)
conditions: Both founders have compatible working styles and trust
bounded_by: Greg does not address cases where founding with a friend destroys the friendship or business

claims.text: Greg (Bloom Nutrition co-founder) states that Bloom was scaling toward selling approximately one million cans of Bloom Energy per day and projecting over $500 million in revenue for the year, reflecting that the business had crossed $1 million in daily revenue.
claims.speaker: Greg (Bloom Nutrition co-founder)
conditions: Approximately 7 years after Leo joined to scale the company

numbers.axis: Bloom Nutrition revenue and unit volume at time of recording

examples.text: Greg describes bringing his best friend Leo into Bloom Nutrition approximately seven years before the recording. Leo joined to help scale the company, and together they grew it to selling nearly one million cans of Bloom Energy per day and exceeding $1 million in daily revenue. Greg uses this example to illustrate his claim that entrepreneurship with a best friend is more rewarding than going it alone.

practices.text: If given the opportunity, build your company alongside a trusted best friend rather than founding solo; the shared journey compounds the rewards of entrepreneurship.
